text: 1 Scope
trace: Contents --> 1 Scope
text_preview: 1 Scope

text: This document is both a Specification and an Informational Report in that it specifies the Information Model and the Data Models that are foundational for O-RAN's model-driven architecture and for the functions carried out over O-RAN interfaces.
trace: Contents --> 1 Scope
text_preview: This document is both a Specification and an Informational Report in that it specifies the Information Model and the Data Models that are foundational for O-RAN's model-driven architecture and for the functions carried out over O-RAN interfaces.

text: In addition, this document includes information about existing standards and industry work that serve as a basis for work items in O-RAN. There is a "prosumer" relationship evolving between O-RAN and 3GPP, as each makes its model available and provides model feedback to the other.
trace: Contents --> 1 Scope
text_preview: In addition, this document includes information about existing standards and industry work that serve as a basis for work items in O-RAN. There is a "prosumer" relationship evolving between O-RAN and 3GPP, as each makes its model available and provides model feedback to the other.

text: Lastly, this document describes the de facto methods and procedures with respect to a "modeling continuum" that aims to establish and evolve an O-RAN Information Model from which O-RAN Data Models may be generated manually or with a set of tools.

text: 5.2.1.4.10.1 Definition
trace: Contents --> 5.2 O-RAN Information Model Definitions --> 5.2.1.4.2 PerformanceMeasureDefinition\_ <<dataType>> --> 5.2.1.4.10.1 Definition
text_preview: 5.2.1.4.10.1 Definition

text: There is more information about an alarm than is included in a notification about an alarm occurrence. The AlarmDictionary provides that data to the SMO such that the extended data may be used to assist in alarm event processing. These could include repair actions which guide a user of the SMO of what to do when the alarm occurs. If the alarm is based on a standard, this could also include the standard-defined descriptions/discussion about the alarm condition.
trace: Contents --> 5.2 O-RAN Information Model Definitions --> 5.2.1.4.2 PerformanceMeasureDefinition\_ <<dataType>> --> 5.2.1.4.10.1 Definition
text_preview: The AlarmDictionary provides extended data to the SMO for alarm event processing. This includes repair actions and standard definitions, guiding users on what to do when an alarm occurs.

text: Along with Network Functions, O-Cloud resources or deployments may generate an alarm notification which are sent to subscribed consumers. The SMO shall be the primary consumer of these events which may need the ability to correlate them when there is a single root cause for alarms from multiple sources. The dictionary definition provides extensibility where such end-to-end type of signatures may be described.
trace: Contents --> 5.2 O-RAN Information Model Definitions --> 5.2.1.4.2 PerformanceMeasureDefinition\_ <<dataType>> --> 5.2.1.4.10.1 Definition
text_preview: O-Cloud resources or deployments may generate alarm notifications sent to subscribed consumers. The SMO is the primary consumer and needs to correlate alarms from multiple sources with a single root cause. This allows for end-to-end type of signatures to be described using extensibility defined in the dictionary.

text: Not all alarms definitions are standardized and therefore the alarm dictionary should be structured to allow a resource and/or application vendors to specify their unique alarms while also supporting alarms which are defined by a standard.

text: Models that are likely to be applicable to more than one O-RAN Alliance working group should provide clear delineation between separate working groups configuration and/or state.
